entities.name: Bre of Clan Stoutarm
entities.description: Mild giant warrior and herder, daughter of Brion Stoutarm.

entities.name: Brion Stoutarm
entities.description: Giant whose death is blamed on the elves.

entities.name: Ferrafor
entities.description: The last known yew on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, cruel in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Sigric
entities.description: Elder treefolk who prophesied the yew's return and died on the journey.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: Treefolk whose sapling was the source of Ferrafor's cutting.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Queen of the fae who died.

entities.name: Mass of Mysteries
entities.description: Greater elemental born after Oona's death that turns the certain into the uncertain.

entities.name: Moira
entities.description: Sentient green slug, friend of the boggart Squen.

entities.name: Auntie Ool
entities.description: Infamous boggart witch, terror of Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Queen Oura
entities.description: Faerie noble who proclaimed herself queen after Oona's defeat.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Faerie leader whom most Lorwyn faeries follow.

entities.name: Snake
entities.description: Sentient blue snake on Shadowmoor, antagonistic to Cragg.

entities.name: Squen
entities.description: Boggart of Lorwyn, friend of Moira.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane of this article's characters.

events.summary: Sigric, Morecote and Erewaker die on the journey to the dawnglove clearing, harried by the Deffroad clique's attempt to resurrect Oona.
events.quote: though all three died along the journey

events.summary: Oura proclaims herself queen by mimicking Oona.
events.quote: Oura proclaimed herself queen by mimicking Oona and gaining power through the collective belief of the fae.

relations.quote: Bre of Clan Stoutarm is a giant warrior and daughter of Brion Stoutarm .
She is a friend of the boggart Squen and rides on his shoulder.
He has an antagonistic relationship with the boggart Cragg.
work to gain more allies while they undermine Maralen .
